LanguageData.PM_Conversion_Description: Convert stored materials by mass into one target material. Inputs are charged together; one stack is delivered per cycle. Existing hyperspace cabinets for the target receive products first. Excess mass is discarded.
LanguageData.PM_Conversion_NoInputs: No eligible materials in this source.
LanguageData.PM_Conversion_DragTip: Drag from a checkbox across rows to select or clear. First selection uses all available units; quantities remain editable. Select all, clear and dragging affect only the current source.
LanguageData.PM_Conversion_DiscardNotice: Output is rounded down; remainder mass is discarded.
LanguageData.PM_Conversion_Busy: The replicator already has a pending conversion.
LanguageData.PM_Conversion_StockChanged: The selected source has insufficient or invalid stock. This batch was not charged.
LanguageData.PM_Conversion_Invalid: The selected material is unavailable for this conversion.
LanguageData.PM_Conversion_TooLittle: The input mass is too small to produce one target item.
LanguageData.PM_Conversion_TooLarge: This batch is too large. Reduce input quantities (maximum 4096 output stacks).
LanguageData.PM_Conversion_CommittedNotice: Materials have been consumed. Remaining products are saved inside the replicator and delivered one stack per cycle; output can be paused.
